name: Clicking the Analysis tab opens an analysis panel with content
description: When the Analysis tab or section control is clicked on a match detail page, the page reveals a panel containing text analysis content rather than a blank or placeholder state.

planSteps.description: Click on any knockout bracket cell to open a match detail page
Wait for the match page to load
Click the Analysis tab or section control
Verify the analysis panel is now visible and contains at least one paragraph of text content (not empty and not a placeholder message like 'coming soon' or 'no analysis available')
